_about: Models Flyweight Desktop recommends. The app reads this file from the main branch on GitHub (falling back to the copy shipped with it), so edits here reach every installed app without a release. Each entry names a Hugging Face repository and the quantizations to prefer, in order; the app looks up the actual file, its size and its SHA-256 itself. 'rank' orders quality (higher is better) among models that fit. 'moe' lets the fit check count system memory for the experts; 'vision' also downloads the repository's mmproj projector. An entry whose repository cannot be found is shown as unavailable, not as a broken download.
